policy.due_dates: No invented due dates. Set only after qualified evidence/data availability.
policy.close_rule: Close milestone only after linked gate evidence, not CI-green or E0 mechanism alone.
policy.release_hold: #1356 DO NOT MERGE until #1345/#1346 and other release-specific gates.

milestones.title: M0 — Trust and authorization
milestones.description: Least-privilege field scope, complete post-scope retrieval semantics and independent evidence-grounded action authorization
milestones.gate: No data-scope-hidden output fields or unauthorized destructive effects; stale source/policy and grounded predicate negatives documented; release-blocking safety evidence triaged.

milestones.title: M1 — Source-native typed G5 graph
milestones.description: One canonical source-pinned OpenAPI/MCP/OPTIMADE typed graph and complete authorized conjunctive field-group coverage before strict K
milestones.gate: G5 graph and FieldGroup complete-set Recall@5 measured on original source-native schemas; typed joins and actual execution bindability independently distinguished, no invented route or authority.

milestones.title: M2 — Multilingual fit and no-fit
milestones.description: Cross-language EN/KO/JA fixed-K candidate selection and independently calibrated unsupported/ambiguous refusal
milestones.gate: Precommitted per-language required-route/field recall and positive false refusal, unsupported false admission; pinned local CPU performance and independent source split; NO_FIT is not cosine threshold or authorization.

milestones.title: M3 — Independent task and provider evidence
milestones.description: Publisher/source-authored disjoint E2 paired full-task comparisons, external standards and SafeAct source/action evidence
milestones.gate: Exact-source and license-reviewed independent task manifest, original provider calls, downstream task/factual grounding, safe no-action; record every external BLOCKED_EXTERNAL explicitly; do not certify E2 for absent authored gold.

milestones.title: M4 — v0.18 controlled release
milestones.description: Qualified release integration and explicit decision only after critical security and independent evidence gates
milestones.gate: #1345 checklists and #1346 publisher evidence reviewed; protected CI, bilingual build and source-verified runtime package; #1356 remains HARD HOLD until explicit go/no-go.

milestones.title: M5 — Postrelease adoption and follow-up
milestones.description: Non-blocking pi-jev/Laya optional candidate, postrelease evaluation, paper package and external adopter evidence
milestones.gate: Do not block v0.18 on optional backends or marketing; any released-vs-baseline study measures actual published versions and disjoint native tasks; adoption and paper outcomes link to raw evidence.
